INDUSTRIAL DISPUTE.

Some 200 workers employed by the "Record" Machine Tools Manufacturing Co., 111 Great Western Road, declared a strike at 9 a.m. September 4th, 1940 in order to enforce their demand for a rice allowance.

Two workers' representatives, namely Sze Ning Tsai (史銀財), and Hsu Ching Huh (徐清和), called in the office of the Industrial Section at 10 a.m. on the same day and requested mediation.

The Industrial Section representative proceeded to the factory at 2 p.m. Negotiations between the Management, represented by Mr. S. Jedeikin, Manager, and the workers took place at the factory premises. Mr. Jedeikin stated that the Management would not consider the granting of any rice allowance under pressure, but said he was willing to grant, at his discretion, any necessary wage increase if the wages in other factories in the same trade were higher than those in his factory. He requested the Industrial Section representative to make an investigation, for his consideration, of wages in other factories engaged in the same type of work, because he wished to pay his workers better than other factories. He also agreed not to dismiss any worker without just cause.

After mediation, and pending a satisfactory reply from the Management within two weeks, the workers agreed to resume work, commencing at 5 p.m.

The dispute is, therefore, temporarily settled.

劳资纠纷。

受雇于大西路111号“Record”机器工具制造公司的约200名工人，为迫使资方满足其发放米贴的要求，于1940年9月4日上午9时宣布罢工。

两名工人代表，即史銀財（Sze Ning Tsai）和徐清和（Hsu Ching Huh），于当日上午10时前往工业科办公室请求调解。

工业科代表于下午2时前往该厂。由经理 S. Jedeikin 先生代表的管理层与工人在厂区内进行了谈判。Jedeikin 先生表示，管理层不会在压力下考虑发放任何米贴，但称如果同行业其他工厂的工资高于本厂，他愿意酌情给予必要的加薪。他请求工业科代表调查从事同类工作的其他工厂的工资情况，供其参考，因为他希望支付给工人的工资优于其他工厂。他还同意不在无正当理由的情况下解雇任何工人。

经调解，并在等待管理层在两周内给予满意答复期间，工人同意恢复工作，自下午5时开始。

因此，该纠纷已暂时解决。
